adjustment.zh: 8 档轴距与 8 档弹力；角棱磁力可调。
adjustment.en: Eight travel and eight compression positions with adjustable piece magnet strength.

highlights.zh: Premium 改进一体式轴心；旗舰版使用弹簧、轴磁与 UV 外壳。
highlights.en: Premium revises the integrated core; Flagship uses springs, a magnetic core and UV coating.

highlights.zh: SAOCube 合作版商品规格单列 20 颗轴心磁铁。
highlights.en: The SAOCube collaboration explicitly specifies 20 core magnets.

summary.zh: 这次重做轴心并改善磁铁固定；改良目标是耐用性和调校，未把商家“不会断轴”的宣传视为已证明结论。
summary.en: The revision redesigns the core and magnet retention; durability and tuning are its goals, without treating breakage-prevention claims as demonstrated guarantees.

tradeoffs.zh: 部分商家把家族磁悬浮文案复制到全部版本；这里按具体版本表核为 Standard/Flagship 弹簧、Pioneer 磁悬浮。
tradeoffs.en: Some retailers repeat family MagLev copy across all variants; the version table identifies spring Standard/Flagship and MagLev Pioneer.

tradeoffs.zh: 调校丰富也意味着更多零件；未给出所有批次统一的可靠性结论。
tradeoffs.en: More tuning brings more components; no universal reliability conclusion is asserted for every batch.
